--(Mt.) the sacred hill at the top of माल्यवत्. Here अङ्गिरस् performed penance for fifteen crores of years; here is the R. विशल्यकरणी, forming a part of Kalinga; सिद्धिक्षेत्रम्, noted for श्राद्ध offering,
1: Br. III. १

.
and पितृ पिण्ड; a क्षेत्र of the नर्मदा by name जलेश्वरा; sur- rounded by the hill रुद्रकोटि; superior to कुरुक्षेत्र;
2: M. २२. २८; १८६. १२-34; १८८. ७९ and ८२; १९१. २५; १९३. ५४; १९४. ४४.
its crest lustrous as the प्रलयाग्नि; there were golden कुशस् touching the bank of the south नर्मदा; here अङ्गिरस्, once after Agnihotra saw the step to स्वर्ग or heaven; on the west is a tank, bordering on Kalinga another holy place. Sung even by शुक्र.
3: वा. ७
--on the western side of गन्धमा- dana. M. ११३. ४८. [page१-082+ २८]
--another term for Heaven whose lord was Indra. Br.
--Heaven noted for the pleasure-park Nan- dana. A description of the city, occupied for some time by

: भा. VIII. १५. ११-22 and ३३; वा. ७७. २६.
Though it was really the capital of Indra, the latter says that it belonged to कृष्ण.
2: भा. X. [६७ (V) २६]; Vi.

. २५.

--the son of Susandhi and father of सहस्वान्. Vi.
--the son of Sandhi and father of Mahasvat. भा. IX. १२. 7.
--a देव गण with Yama as their lord. Br.
--a ray of the sun. Vi. II. १२. 8.
(II)--a son of कृष्ण and (सत्या) daughter of Nagnacit. भा. X. ६१. १३. [page१-166+ २४]
--their irritation against king, a cause of internal dissensions; to be banished after being deprived of possession, for doing wrongs: Residence of. M. २२३. 9; २२७. १६०; २५४. २१-22. [page१-083+ ३१]
(I)--a son of Aila. Him अच्छोदा adopted as her पितृ and lost her yogic powers; son of पुरूरवस् and उर्वशी. Father of भीम. Br. III. १०. ५६ and ६८; ६६. २२; M. १४. 5, 7. वा. ९१. ५१. 2; Vi.
(II)--the son of आयु; a Vasu passing through the sky loved by अच्छोदा. वा. ७३. 5.

--the time when पितृस् worship moon and when the sun, moon and constellations meet together in the same मण्डल; पितृस् drink the nectar of the moon (1/१५) part of it remaining; there is no moon, middle sun--half night half day.

यज्ञस् with २१ सम्ज्ञस्।
2: Br. III. ११. १४. वा. ७४. १३.
Only when two of its कलस् remain, the moon enters the orbit of the sun and stays in the ray called अमा and hence the period is अमावास्या,
3: Vi. I. २०. ३८;
--a शक्ति devi1 on the सोडशपत्राब्ज। Br. IV. ३२. १२.
--called कुहू because it casts the length of time a cuckoo takes to say कुहू। M. १४१. ४२, ४९.
--the milking vessel of the यक्षस्. Br. II. ३६. २१५; वा. ६२. १८२.
--gift of uncooked food in a श्राद्ध, gene- rally by शूद्रस्; also आमश्राद्धम्; forbidden for yatis. M. १७. ७०; वा. १८. २०.
